chunks: Do not flee; go back to your halls of pleasure and your habitations, so that you may be interrogated.
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran mean by 'Do not flee' in Surah Al-Anbiya?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as addressing the inhabitants of Paradise who, in their joy, might rush to greet the newly admitted or to witness the reckoning of others. It emphasizes that even in the highest state of bliss, believers remain subject to divine inquiry regarding their conduct and gratitude, reinforcing the concept of continuous accountability (Hisab) beyond mere entry into Jannah.
